paragraphs: Naḥum the elder, a baraita, Berakhot 48b: R. Eliezer says whoever omitted 'a desirable land' in Grace after Meals has not fulfilled the obligation. Naḥum the elder says one must mention the covenant; R. Yose says one must mention Torah. Pelimo says covenant and Torah. Yuḥasin is uncertain whether he is Naḥum the scribe or Naḥum the Mede. This requires examination: Pelimo lived in Rabbi's time, and Rabbi became nasi close to ninety years after the destruction—see part 1—while both Naḥums above were much earlier.
